_meta.citation: Wei et al. (2024), Reconstructing long-term (1980-2022) daily ground particulate matter concentrations in India (LongPMInd), Earth System Science Data 16, 3565-3577, doi:10.5194/essd-16-3565-2024. Data: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.14557027, CC BY 4.0.
_meta.reconstruction_note: A validated estimate, not a measurement. India had almost no continuous monitoring before the 2010s, so every figure before then is what a model says the air was, not what an instrument recorded.
_meta.not_comparable_with: Do not difference these against the site's 2024 annual layer: that is SatPM2.5 V6GL03 at ~1 km, this is LongPMInd at ~10 km. Use this for trend and shape, that for level.
_meta.winter_note: Winter takes December from the same calendar year, matching build-boundary-seasonal.py.
_meta.point_sampled_note: A district marked "pt" is smaller than one ~10 km cell, so it carries the value of the cell its centroid falls in rather than a mean over its own area. Chandigarh, Daman and several Delhi districts are in this position.
